name: Hiab Oyj
summary: Hiab Oyj engages in providing road load handling solutions. It operates through the Equipment and Services segments. The Equipment segment comprises loader cranes, forestry and recycling cranes, truck-mounted forklifts, demountable lifts, and tail lifts. The Services segment covers spare parts, maintenance, accessories, installations, digital services, and refurbished equipment. The company was founded by Eric Sundin in 1944 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
